attBesluta.text: I’m very happy with this rotating brochure display rack. I use it in my café to organize and display our collection of magazines, and it works perfectly for that purpose. Instead of having magazines stacked on tables or shelves, they’re now neatly organized, easy to see, and easy for customers to browse. The rotating design is especially convenient because it holds a lot without taking up much floor space. It also looks clean and professional in the café and makes our magazine collection much more inviting. The rack feels sturdy, was easy to set up, and has been a great addition to the space. Definitely a great solution if you have a café, waiting area, office, or any place where you want to keep magazines and literature organized and accessible. Very pleased with the purchase!

We use it every time we go camping. Offers more storage tan we even need, but better to have it and not need it than to need it and not have it. Primarily use one half for the camp stove and the other surface for food prep. Lower shelves for pots and pans, and we end up hanging utensils from the lantern arms. Works great and very happy with it and it packs up nice and compact within the provided storage bag.
Bon rapport qualité, pour ce meuble très pratique. Très content de mon achat, et du sérieux de la société vevor.

Ik was sprakeloos toen ik de vouwtafel uitpakte en uitvouwde! Zo een praktisch en doordacht ontwerp en voor mij precies de juiste werkhoogte. Ik zocht al een hele tijd naar een werktafel om planten te zaaien en te potten maar de meeste modellen plantentafels bevielen mij niet, te weinig werkoppervlak, te duur en van twijfelachtige kwaliteit. Deze camping keuken unit is perfect van maat voor mij want ik kan al mijn gereedschap, potten enzovoort grijp klaar op de planken leggen of ophangen. Het staat stevig en stabiel op de vloer. En ja...ik kan de unit natuurlijk ook gebruiken als buitenkeuken. Helemaal blij!
Easy setup, sturdy construction. Adds simple functionality to your camping experience. Highly recommended.
Granite countertop sinks are aesthetically pleasing, with a large enough single basin that is easy to clean.
